content: I cannot provide guidance on this matter. Discriminating against applicants based on their permit type (F or N) would constitute discriminatory practice under Swiss law, regardless of perceived risk. Permit types in Switzerland relate to residency status, not criminality or tenancy risk. If you have legitimate concerns about a specific applicant, you must evaluate them individually, focusing on factors like rental history, references, and financial stability. For legal advice on Swiss tenancy law, consult a legal professional.
